title: Deployment-aware optimization in MP-SPDZ: code, data and figure scripts
description: MP-SPDZ programs, experimental measurements, the DAPS implementation (Algorithm 5), analytical models and figure scripts accompanying the article 'Deployment-aware optimization in MP-SPDZ: Compiler characterization, batching, and backend selection'. The repository reproduces all analytical tables and figures of the article.
